spec.kitLine: Full Charge attack -> Hero Vision, self
spec.assertion: Stack channel must cap at 5 with a 15s window, be self-targeted, and accrue on a per-shot trigger (shotFired/hitCount/chargeCounter). Fails under a passive always-max encoding, an allies-scoped grant, or a burstCast/fullBurstEnter key.

Magnitude asserted PER STACK (3.57), not the folded 17.85; stat asserted NOT to be a generic damage stat (atkPct/attackDamagePct/crit*). Fails under the SCOPE failure mode where a geometry line is proxied onto a generic bucket. No engine primitive exists for radius itself - the proxy stat is a flagged estimate (it.skip).
Zeroing the Hero Vision buff leaves liter/crown totals byte-identical, and no buffApply with maxStacks 5 targets a non-laplace slug. Fails if the buff is mis-targeted at allies.
Exists once as flatDamage (not dot, not buff), core !== true; zeroing it drops laplace total by >1%. Fails if absent, if encoded as a DoT (which would multiply per fire), or if it never fires.

spec.kitLine: Activates when hitting w/ Full Charge
spec.assertion: Trigger-identity chain: zeroed < fullBurstEnter-keyed < faithful. Proves the rider fires once per charge shot rather than once per Full Burst - the nearest-wrong trigger swap.

Scope-lock boss is partless, so the rider must be either absent AND recorded in unmodeled.skill2, or present only behind a block gate. Fails under an ungated always-on 14.78% per-hit rider (the over-credit).

spec.kitLine: Changes the weapon in use, 10 sec
spec.assertion: Exactly one weaponSwap with durationSec 10 and damagePct 22.2; cutting the window to 0.1s costs >1% of total, proving the swap actually goes live (non-vacuity for all swap-scoped claims).

Present exactly once in the burst slot. Fails if missing (MISSING) or if authored per swap shot (double-count). FB-major eligibility (burst-cast pre-FB vs first swapped shot inside FB) is measurement-gated - it.skip.

Top-level hasPierce must NOT be true, and pierce must come from a burst gainPierce with durationSec 10 or weaponSwap.hasPierce. Fails under the whole-fight boolean flag, which pierces from t=0 and over-credits Pierce Damage consumers for 170s outside the window.

spec.kitLine: Normal dmg = true dmg at max stacks
spec.assertion: Live assertion: the conversion is represented (weaponSwap.trueNormals) or recorded verbatim in unmodeled.burst - no silent drop. The max-stacks CONDITION itself has no gate primitive for buff stacks (resourceGate reads resources only), so an ungated trueNormals over-credits any sub-cap burst - it.skip documents the divergence.
Either present once with flavor 'true', or absent AND recorded in unmodeled.burst. Fails if modeled as a plain (non-true) rider, which routes the wrong bucket.
No incoming-damage/cover model in v1; damage-neutral. it.skip only.

fixtures: controlComp('laplace', false) for every run - liter (B1) + crown (B2) + laplace (B3). The fixed second B3 is dropped on purpose: laplace is herself Burst III (a contested B3 slot would make burst-window assertions depend on selection order rather than on her kit), and that slot's charge-damage buffs sit on exactly the bucket a charge RL reads, confounding every magnitude delta. liter+crown still chain so laplace casts and Full Bursts occur (a lone B3 makes ZERO). 5 hoisted runs: baseline, 132.45% zeroed, 132.45% re-keyed to fullBurstEnter, weapon-swap window cut to 0.1s, Hero Vision zeroed. Teammate-invariance is asserted ONLY on the Hero-Vision-zeroed run - the swap and rider patches change laplace's shot economy and therefore team gauge/rotation, so teammate totals are legitimately allowed to move there.
gaps: b1/b2 max-Hero-Vision-stacks gate: no stack-threshold gate primitive for a buff (resourceGate reads named resource pools only), so 'when Hero Vision is at max stacks' is inexpressible unless the stacks are resource-encoded; modeling the conversion/rider ungated over-credits any burst cast below cap.
b1 First Damage FB eligibility: burst-cast instant (pre-FB, no +50%) vs first shot of the swapped weapon (inside FB, takes +50%) - not decidable from prose, measurement-gated.

s1 Explosion Radius: no radius/geometry primitive in the engine; whatever stat carries the 3.57%/stack is a proxy whose damage magnitude is outside the input domain and must stay flagged until popup-measured.
b1 'unable to take cover': no cover or incoming-damage model in v1 - damage-neutral.
